links.outcome: Accuracy of sentence-level source attribution to supporting text spans or images
links.effect: Text F1 over 92% on radiology and 88% on dialogue summarization, substantially outperforming embedding-based and self-attribution baselines.
links.quote: For source attribution, ClinTrace achieves over 92% text F1 on radiology and 88% on dialogue summarization, substantially outperforming embedding-based and self-attribution baselines.

links.outcome: Faithfulness improvement from groundedness-based abstention on summary output
links.effect: Abstaining on the least-grounded 20% of output raised faithfulness from 61.7% to 72.6%; groundedness AUROC 0.77 with the medical-finetuned model.
links.quote: For hallucination detection, groundedness scores achieve 0.77 AUROC with the medical-finetuned model: competitive with embedding-based confidence at zero additional cost, and enable an abstention mechanism that improves faithfulness from 61.7% to 72.6% by withholding the least: grounded 20% of output for clinician review.

unlisted_practices: Training-free attention-based groundedness scoring with abstention that withholds low-support sentences for clinician review

screen.practice: selective abstention / uncertainty-based filtering for clinician review
screen.reason: Evaluates an attention-based groundedness auditing and abstention safeguard (ClinTrace) that withholds poorly grounded summary sentences for clinician review to improve overall faithfulness.
